 --> Derived.sol:5:1:
  |
5 | contract Derived is Base {}
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
Note: Type only supported by ABIEncoderV2
 --> Base.sol:4:45:
  |
4 | contract Base { struct S { uint256 value; } function f(S memory value) public virtual {} }
  |                                             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
errors.message: Contract "Derived" does not use ABI coder v2 but wants to inherit from a contract which uses types that require it. Use "pragma abicoder v2;" for the inheriting contract as well to enable the feature.
